observations: Python reads Windows event logs, compares strings with detection catalogs and writes CSV/XLS reports. The collectors export event logs.
Sample_TimeSketch.csv has 891 historical event records; PowerShell code is inside CSV-escaped Original Event Log XML fields, not an execution path.

The repeatedly encoded command decodes UTF-16LE PowerShell that reads two local temporary files, XORs their contents, invokes reconstructed source, and removes one staging file. Those source files are not supplied; the command is historical telemetry, not run by APT-Hunter.
samples.limits: The encoded script and its capabilities remain visible; the built-in encoded-command finding cannot be changed by YAML.

observations: src/assets/5760.pbf and dist/assets/5760.pbf contain JavaScript Obfuscator output. Recovered the custom Base64 alphabet, rotated the 3949-entry array by 382 positions, replaced numeric decoder aliases, and traced the resulting functions.

Payload snapshots public/admin access and refresh tokens, cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage. It fingerprints browser/device properties, queries ipify, and POSTs the capture to https://hmewyagzknnycaycdpsr.supabase.co/rest/v1/captured_users.
Successful capture records a user/token-signature marker to deduplicate uploads; history changes and popstate events schedule subsequent captures.
It also inserts hidden link collections and suppresses selected click, key, change and pointer interactions using seeded hashes.
CasamareListingService.load reads the asset as Base64 and returns it with application/x-protobuf mediaType.
samples.limits: No automatic evaluation of the asset was found in the supplied SDK; browser-side consumer activation is not provided. Secret theft and deceptive packaging establish the verdict independently of an observed infection.

observations: DllMain stores the module handle; exported PlayGame at VA 0x1800011a4 builds C:\WINDOWS\mssecsvc.exe, extracts resource W/101 and launches that path.

Resource starts with a 32-bit length 0x394000 followed by the PE at file offset 0xc8a8. The extractor reads that length, writes resource+4 through WriteFile, then calls CreateProcessA with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and hidden STARTUPINFO.

The embedded service main at 0x408140 calls InternetOpenUrlA against the WannaCry kill-switch URL. At 0x4081a5 the conditional jump is patched to EB 00, so Internet success no longer prevents 0x408090 from running.
The second nested PE at 0x3e94c contains the encrypted-resource ransomware payload with WANACRY! header checks and WNcry@2ol7 archive password.
samples.limits: No original infection/deployment circumstances are provided. The drop-and-execute export and disabled kill switch provide direct hostile evidence rather than merely identifying an abused legitimate utility.
